mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust residential construction activity and consumer confidence, which typically translates to stronger corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing that reduces equity discount rates and stimulates risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by >=0.2pp and PAYEMS increases by >=100k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE decreases by >=0.2pp and PAYEMS increases by >=100k in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession (GDPC1 growth < 0% quarterly), a rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals the start of economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 0% and INDPRO increases by >=0.5% in the last quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.0% indicates persistent inflation that typically triggers monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) reflects strong aggregate consumer demand, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >=0.5% and RSAFS increases by >=0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by >=0.5% and RSAFS increases by >=0.3% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% and UNRATE decreases by >=0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing output and business investment, which typically translates to improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
